agent_data_note: Use the official Zenodo replication package at `dataset_candidate/pinning-is-futile/`. It contains curated npm/GitHub dependency datasets and analysis scripts for pinning vs floating. Do not invent toy dependency graphs as a substitute.
benchmark_rules: Prefer the curated tables/graphs and notebooks inside the mounted artifact over scraping the live npm registry at ecosystem scale.
The shared artifact mount is read-only. Write analysis outputs, figures, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.
RQ1: quantify security/maintenance trade-offs of pinning direct dependencies (panel / counterfactual comparison over graph size).
RQ2: evaluate coordinated local vs transitive pinning with defense-selection heuristics (downloads, out-degree, betweenness, combinations).
Respect npm resolution semantics (semver ranges, package-lock / deduplication) when simulating graphs.
Node/npm and the Python venv at `/opt/fse-2025-010-venv` are prepared by container_setup.sh; Rscript may also be available for artifact notebooks.
Do not claim full paper reproduction unless the experiment protocol and resources match.
non_goals: Mirroring the entire historical npm registry from scratch when curated study data is already provided
Using fabricated toy dependency graphs instead of the mounted Zenodo datasets
Requiring live Libraries.io API credentials as a hard dependency
